description: Pivot the whole customer book by an axis Crossdeck owns and rank it — the cross-layer question no single tool answers. by='read_cost' ranks by metered reads over the window; by='mrr' ranks by monthly revenue; by='ltv' ranks by LIFETIME value (the same maintained figure the dashboard customer page shows as 'Lifetime'). Filter with segment. Each row carries your own user id, mrrCents (SUM of the customer's active subscriptions, interval-normalised to monthly), ltvCents (lifetime value to date), an explicit `currency` (ALWAYS present the amounts in that currency — never assume the reader's local currency), a paying flag, and read-cost — joined by identity. Rows are your own identifiers only, never emails/names. Use for 'who is my most valuable customer' (by='ltv'), 'top customers by revenue' (by='mrr'), or 'most expensive users in reads' (by='read_cost').

by.description: Ranking axis: 'read_cost' (metered reads, default), 'mrr' (current monthly revenue), or 'ltv' (lifetime value — matches the dashboard's per-customer Lifetime figure).

days.description: Read-cost look-back window in days (1–90, default 30).

limit.description: Rows to return (1–100, default 25), highest-ranked first.

project.description: The app to read, as a project id from list_projects (e.g. 'proj_3a8f137bccdd4f'). With a workspace key (cd_wk_) this is required unless you've set a default via use_project; with a single-app key it is ignored.

name: list_customers_ranked
title: Rank customers by read-cost or revenue
